# Fibo Planner

> Real-time planning poker in one process. No accounts, no database. People estimate a story with Fibonacci cards over a WebSocket, then the room shows a tally and whether the votes meet the agreement rules.

Fibo Planner is a small web app for agile estimation. A room is a shared session: a topic, a list of people, their votes, and consensus settings. Anyone who has joined the room can change the topic, the vote queue, and the agreement rules. There is no facilitator role.

Use the HTTP and WebSocket steps below to run a session. The HTML pages are the human UI; an agent can ignore them after it has a room id.

## Pages

- [Home](/): create a room and see live lobby counts
- [Room](/100000): room page; the id is six digits assigned at creation (100000–999999)
- [Disclaimer](/disclaimer): stock disclaimer
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): what the server stores (nothing durable) and what it logs
- [Terms of Use](/terms): how to use a hosted copy
- [Agent guide](/llms.txt): this file

## Create a room

`POST /rooms` with `Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded`.

- `name` — optional room label, trimmed, at most 120 Unicode characters. This is the room title, not a person's name.
- Response: `303` redirect to `/{roomID}`. Read the id from the `Location` path. The id is six digits and does not change.
- A missing room returns `404` for both `GET /{roomID}` and the room WebSocket.

Example:

```
POST /rooms
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

name=Sprint%2042%20backlog
```

Empty rooms are deleted after 30 minutes with no WebSocket connections. Creating a room starts that timer; connecting a participant cancels it.

## Join and vote

Open a WebSocket at `/ws/{roomID}` (for example `/ws/123456`).

- Send the display name in the first text frame, not in the URL. The access log records the path, so a `?name=` query would store the name. Do not put the name in the query string.
- First message must be JSON: `{"name":"Ada"}`. Later messages are ignored until this arrives. A blank name is stored as `Guest`. Names are trimmed and cut at 120 characters.
- The browser reconnects with the same JSON. Do the same if the socket drops.
- A client that sends no `Origin` header is accepted. Browsers must send a same-origin `Origin`, unless the operator listed extra origins in `FIBO_PLANNER_WS_ORIGINS`.

After the join is accepted, send one JSON object per action. Unknown fields are ignored. Invalid JSON is ignored.

Vote (voters only):

```json
{"points":"8"}
```

Allowed `points` values are `"1"`, `"2"`, `"3"`, `"5"`, `"8"`, `"13"`, `"20"`, and `""` (clear your vote). A number is accepted too (`{"points":8}`). Any other value is ignored. An observer's vote is ignored.

## Room controls

Every joined socket can send these. `admin` is a string.

- `{"admin":"clear-votes"}` — clear every vote. Does not change the topic.
- `{"admin":"set-topic","topic-title":"Login story"}` — set the story title (trimmed, max 120 characters). An empty title clears it.
- `{"admin":"set-preloaded-topics","preloaded-topics":"Login story\nPay flow"}` — replace the queue. One title per line, blank lines skipped, each title max 120 characters, at most 200 titles. A missing or empty field clears the queue.
- `{"admin":"load-next-topic"}` — set the topic to the first queued title, drop that title, and clear votes. No effect when the queue is empty.
- `{"admin":"always-show-votes"}` — toggle the room-wide switch. There is no separate "off" message; send it again to flip back.
- `{"admin":"observer-mode"}` — toggle the sender only. Observers are listed as `observer`, their vote is cleared, and they do not have to vote before results appear. This is not an admin role.
- `{"admin":"consensus-agreement","percentage":80,"max-spread":1}` — set either or both. `percentage` is an integer 50–100. `max-spread` is an integer 0–6. An out-of-range field is skipped; the other field still applies. Defaults are 100 and 0.

Presets, if you want both knobs at once:

- Full: percentage 100, max spread 0
- Good: percentage 80, max spread 1
- Relaxed: percentage 50, max spread 3

## What the server sends

Room sockets receive HTML fragments, not JSON. Each update replaces elements by id (`hx-swap-oob="true"`). Read these ids:

- `session-count` — number of joined sockets
- `user-list` — table of name and points. Your row has `class="current-user"`. Voters sort before observers, then by name.
- `topic-title` — current story. The `hidden` attribute means there is no topic.
- `preloaded-topics-data` — remaining queue, one title per line, inside a hidden `<pre>`
- `load-next-topic` — disabled when the queue is empty; otherwise the button label includes the queue length
- `always-show-votes` — `aria-pressed="true"` when votes are visible as they arrive
- `observer-mode` — `aria-pressed` reflects the recipient, not the room
- `consensus-controls` — current percentage and max spread
- `vote-results` — tally (points, count, percent). Hidden until every voter has a non-blank card. A leading value has `class="vote-leader"`.
- `agreed-points` — `Agreed Points:` plus the value, or `N/A`. Class `agreed-yes` or `agreed-no`. Hidden while votes are still out.
- `agreement-status` — whether the leading share and the spread meet the rules. `met` / `unmet`.

Until reveal, every non-blank vote in `user-list` is the text `???`, including your own row. The browser fills your cell back in locally; a WebSocket client does not get that. Remember the points you sent. When always-show is on, the table contains the real values immediately.

Results stay hidden while any non-observer still has a blank vote. Observers do not block reveal. With only observers, results stay hidden.

Agreement, once everyone has voted:

- Spread is the distance on the card scale between the lowest and highest vote. Cards in order are 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 20, so 3 and 5 have spread 1, and 1 and 20 have spread 6. Observers are left out.
- The leading percentage must meet the threshold. At 50 the share must be greater than 50%. At 100 it must be 100%. Otherwise it must be at least the threshold.
- Spread must be less than or equal to max spread.
- Agreed points are the card values that meet the percentage. If the spread is too wide, or no value meets the percentage, agreed points are `N/A`.

## Lobby

`GET /` is the home page. Its live counts use a second WebSocket, `GET /ws`, which pushes an HTML table `lobby-overview` (people on the lobby, number of rooms, people in rooms). You do not need this socket to create or join a room.

Room ids are not listed unless the process was started with `FIBO_PLANNER_LOBBY_LIST_ROOMS=Y`. Otherwise keep the id from the create redirect or from the link a person shared.

## Limits

- Display names, room names, and topic titles: 120 characters
- Preloaded topics: 200 lines
- WebSocket message: 128 KiB
- Vote cards: 1, 2, 3, 5, 8, 13, 20, or blank
- Consensus percentage: 50–100; max spread: 0–6
- Idle room lifetime: 30 minutes with zero room sockets
